email.body1:
Matthew, saw Reveal pull Logikcull and IPRO together into a roughly $1B eDiscovery business with enterprise demand climbing.

After acquisitions that size, the corporate account list usually outpaces what the team can cover before the buying window closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your West corporate motion off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for Reveal.

Post-acquisition, corporate pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your West team needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for Reveal.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your corporate reply rate likely compares to other legal software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling corporate pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating two acquisitions keeps the whole sales org heads-down for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your corporate motion? I'll tailor it to Reveal either way.
